query: SELECT slug, title, year, publishedAt, FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(publishedAt)) as readable_date FROM projects WHERE discipline = 'experiential_design' AND slug IN ('red-bull-jukebox', 'rab-bothy-activation', 'first-bank-lollipop-pop-up') ORDER BY publishedAt DESC;
